name: Gorilla
method: Independent manual source-pixel landmarks and explicit polygons. No donor authoring coordinates, labels, source pixels or reference-self transfer.
limitations: Two long arms and two bent hind legs are painted. The far foot is a small horizontal patch behind the near forearm, with its proximal chain partly occluded; its hip/knee coordinates are fit hypotheses, not directly visible internal joints.

The unchanged automatic silhouette observer counts only three ground clusters because the far foot and near hand share a connected lower silhouette. This packet does not override that measurement or assert four independently separated ground contacts.
The right arm ends in partly open curled fingers, not a clean flat knuckle pad. Terminal heights differ by roughly 25–40 pixels; grounded movement and finger/hand skin quality remain unmeasured.

No tail is painted and the named Gorilla is an ape. The existing primate absent-tail contract is used; no tail or independently articulated ear is invented. Head, beard and nape boundaries need moving-paint review.

name: Capuchin
method: Independent manual source-pixel landmarks and explicit polygons. No donor authoring coordinates, labels, source pixels or reference-self transfer.
limitations: Four limbs and their terminal hands/feet are visibly separate. The forward right hand is curled and raised; hind feet are higher than the nearer hand. This is an arboreal stepping pose, not four proven common-plane supports.

The complete long curled tail is partitioned into the existing tail0/tail1/tail2 chain. The distal loop is one rigid skin owner because this contract has only three tail joints; no extra joint or straightened/repainted tail is invented.
Far shoulder and far hip attachments are partially hidden by torso fur. Their points are transparent authoring hypotheses; terminal tips and exterior bends are independently visible.

The unchanged observer labels the 22.23% tail appendage as top and returns five ground fragments, partly split fingers. This hand packet does not rewrite those measurements or claim improved automatic admission.
